purpose: Committed corpus so CI can run npm test without the private manualos-test-corpus store. files is the small set the corpus walk builds. supporting_files are the redistributable sources for the parser and quality tests that otherwise skip.
notes: Only MIT, Apache-2.0, public-domain and original ManualOS files are committed. See NOTICE.md. GPL, CC-BY and CERN-OHL files are kept out of the repo; tests that need them skip unless MANUALOS_CORPUS points at the full private corpus.
